# Costco Q4 2026 Earnings Summary: Strong Sales Growth and Membership Loyalty

Costco Wholesale reported strong financial results for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, which ended on August 30, 2026. The company demonstrated solid growth in revenue, profitability, and membership engagement, highlighting the continued strength of its membership-based business model.

**Revenue and Profitability**

Costco's quarterly net sales increased **11.2% year over year to $93.9 billion**, compared with $84.4 billion in the same period last year. Net income rose 14.9% to approximately $3.0 billion, while diluted earnings per share (EPS) increased from $5.87 to $6.75. However, EPS included a one-time benefit of $0.15 from tariff refunds. Excluding this benefit, EPS growth was approximately 12.4%.
